verdict.rationale: Open WebUI documents a provider-agnostic interface that connects to Ollama, OpenAI-compatible and Open Responses providers. OpenRouter and similar services are added as OpenAI providers with a custom base URL, and users can switch models mid-conversation or run two side by side. Native Anthropic and Google connections are not documented; Claude appears only as a Claude Code CLI backend in the Computer ecosystem. Per-agent model assignment is only implied through custom models added by Functions. missing for 10: explicit native Anthropic and Google provider support, documented per-agent model selection, independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-provider switching.

support.subject: As a power user, I can plug in multiple model providers — Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, OpenRouter, and more — and switch models per agent or per conversation
